description: Stories must show user/system journey flow with context (when/why), not just list operations. Order by user journey, not technical sequence.

do.description: Show journey with context and flow
content: Include WHEN and WHY, not just WHAT
Show logical flow: Initialize → Validate → Process → Confirm → Complete
Example: User invokes → System validates → System processes → System confirms

dont.description: Don't create isolated stories without journey
content: Don't order by technical sequence instead of user journey
